assessments.rationale: The records cover 22 units, mostly changes to dependency and configuration files. They added dependencies such as commons-httpclient to the login tool and the OpenSearch reindex-client, set up Playwright in CI and Maven files, and changed configuration defaults and Spring bean definitions. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records show no case where other people depended on the person's dependency judgement or handed over work to them, and the explained cause appears in only a single review.

assessments.rationale: The records cover 24 units of persistence work, as author and as reviewer. As author, the person moved the Polls, Tags and user audit log services from older persistence code to JPA repositories, added services and tests, and updated dependent code in several modules. The person also fixed slow or failing queries by adding a composite calendar index, moving audit log paging into SQL, preloading authorization in one query and loading only assessment settings. Other changes fixed a duplicate-key problem with a find-or-update method, a varchar comparison, a @Lob column and named query parameters. The person also added realm and LTI SQL scripts across database dialects. As reviewer, the person traced query cost through call chains, explained Hibernate bulk deletes and merge handling, and suggested pushing paging into queries, using an indexed id lookup and letting the database sort. Reviewer comments also raised transactions and duplicate aliases.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Others rely on it" because the person replaced the Polls persistence with new JPA repositories and a PollsService, and the managers, controllers and entity code now depend on them. The same pattern appears in the Tags service, where consumers in several modules were adapted. It is not "Sets the approach for others" because the records show no case of the person setting a persistence approach or convention that other people then follow. The shared layers appear as the person's own work rather than as guidance for others.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The records show 144 debugging units, mostly fixes the person wrote and a few review comments. In about sixty of the fixes, code comments, commit text or discussion named the cause, for example a returning session overwriting completed visits, a null role for a delegated-access user, stale cached answer hashes after republish, and an inverted read flag after an earlier change. Several of these restructured the code instead of patching one spot, such as changing the presence map to a list per session and reconciling group submitters. Roughly seventy other fixes added guards, corrected conditions, or changed encodings and defaults, usually without a written cause, and most were approved. The person, as reviewer, diagnosed a double list reversal, reference versus value comparison of dates, and a wrong-student launch path, and also asked questions about a possible reprocessing loop and a logged stack trace.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because the person fixed the lost presence duration in SAK-52842 and wrote in a code comment that a returning session overwrote completed visits before the batch was saved. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records do not show other people depending on the person's debugging work, such as their diagnoses being used as a reference or their fixes becoming shared pieces that others build on.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

evidence.title: SAK-49823 Samigo fix issue where site title changes (#13153)
evidence.note: Changed the Samigo settings beans and queries so the release-to target no longer depends on the site title. In discussion they proposed defaulting to the site when no group or anonymous match is found, and a conversion to IDs.

evidence.title: SAK-52854 Messages make private-message FAQ publishing configurable (#14858)
evidence.note: Fixed implicit FAQ forum creation on viewing a private message by adding a config flag and guarding the init and action paths; separated get-or-create so creation only happens on explicit Post to FAQ. Stated the cause in a comment.

evidence.title: SAK-51375 Content fix Edit Folder Permissions in sub-folder (#13631)
evidence.note: Fixed the Edit Folder Permissions error for sub-folders. They skipped the containing-collection lookup for site-root paths and made the web API fall back to parent folders until an authz group is found. The discussion comment explains the override reference.

evidence.title: SAK-51809 Scorm fix sorting and use student's surname and given name (#14029)
evidence.note: Fixed the participant ordering on SCORM results. The comparator now sorts by the surname-first sort name, replaces spaces so multi-word surnames sort correctly, and falls back to displayId on ties. Display and breadcrumbs now use the sort name.

evidence.title: SAK-52857 Lessons recognize deleted linked quizzes (#14922)
evidence.note: Fixed deleted linked quizzes still showing in Lessons. The code comment names the cause, a cached assessment that predates deletion. The fix checks the published assessment status against DEAD_STATUS and also adjusts the student-view conditions.

evidence.title: SAK-51736 Content Default to UTF-8 charset for text-based files served via direct access (#13957)
evidence.note: Fixed garbled non-ASCII characters in directly served text files by appending a UTF-8 charset to any text/* content type in BaseContentService. A code comment states the purpose of the change; two approvals were recorded.

evidence.title: SAK-51705 Kernel singleInstanceStore should also count soft deleted files (#13908)
evidence.note: The author fixed a bug where a shared file was removed from disk while another reference still existed in the soft-deleted table. The reference count now includes both the main and the deleted resource tables. A code comment states the reason.

evidence.title: SAK-51316 SiteStats Fix pagination ListenerInvocationNotAllowedException (#13574)
evidence.note: The author fixed a Wicket pagination exception by disabling page versioning on the paging links, navigator, and pages. They added a request-cycle listener for StalePageException and wrote code comments naming the cause.

evidence.title: SAK-52935 Conversations correct thread upvote total (#15067)
evidence.note: Fixed a sign error in ConversationsServiceImpl so that upvoting a reply increments the parent thread's upvote total instead of decrementing it. Their own comment explains the faulty behaviour, its effect on activity sorting, and the intended behaviour.

evidence.title: SAK-42135 Samigo remove stray toggleNegativePointVal (#13148)
evidence.note: Removed a leftover call to an undefined JavaScript function from the multiple choice JSP. In discussion they tried to reproduce the error locally and linked the commit that introduced the regression.

evidence.title: SAK-51799 SiteInfo Fix URL replacement during site import (#14425)
evidence.note: Fixed the import bug where the site info URL kept the old site ID. Added a fallback that replaces the site ID directly when resource transfer returns the URL unchanged, and treats a blank transfer result as unresolved.

evidence.title: SAK-51536 Gradebook improve handling custom export options and consistent columns in CSV export (#13875)
evidence.note: Fixed misaligned CSV export columns in ExportPanel. Wrote a root cause analysis in the discussion covering student number inconsistency and header/data mismatch. Made header and data row logic consistent for custom export options.

evidence.title: SAK-52844 Discussions correct unread synoptic count (#14875)
evidence.note: The author fixed the unread count by changing the transition checks in the message manager. The discussion comment names the cause: after SAK-49440 inverted the read argument, the counter still used the old meaning. A code comment explains the inverted check.

evidence.title: SAK-52847 Assignments preserve submission time in Grader history (#14882)
evidence.note: The author fixed the history entry so it shows the earlier submission time instead of the grading time. They captured the previous submission date before it is overwritten, with a fallback to the graded date when it is null, and explained this in a code comment.

evidence.title: SAK-52576 LTI fix stealthed tool link launches (#14611)
evidence.note: The author traced the fault to an earlier change (SAK-50758) that hid stealthed tools unless a deployment row existed. They explained that existing links only have lti_content.tool_id, so getTool returned null. They then fixed it in BaseLTIService and DBLTIService.

evidence.title: SAK-51279 Conversations Fix duplicate key violation when marking posts as viewed (#13741)
evidence.note: Fixed a duplicate-key error on topic status by adding a repository method that looks up the existing record, updates it or inserts it, and handles constraint violations from concurrent creation. Three call sites in the service now use it.

evidence.title: SAK-51027 Forums Date read-only option toggles Lock Topic, requi… (#14335)
evidence.note: The change stops the read-only-after-close option from setting the stored Lock flag. Locked state is now computed from the close date in the permissions and message managers. When saving a topic, the code compares the persisted close date with the new one and clears a stale lock.

evidence.title: SAK-52770 Resources preserve public and authenticated access on import (#14928)
evidence.note: Fixed import so public and logged-in-user role access is carried over to the imported folders and files. A helper copies only those two roles from the source and its inherited roles, skips roles the target already inherits, and leaves group permissions out.

evidence.title: SAK-50999 Assignments the personal extension date should not be overridden by a resubmission date (#13307)
evidence.note: The person fixed the submission logic so a personal extension is not overridden by a resubmission date. Code comments in the fix explain that a dummy submission with no submitted date was never truly submitted by the student.

evidence.title: SAK-51551 SiteManage set a consistent value for course_site_publish_service.num_days_before_term_starts (#13791)
evidence.note: The person identified a mismatch between the publish job default (14 days) and the displayed default (0), and changed the job code to read the property with a consistent default of 0, so the two now agree.

evidence.title: SAK-52850 Samigo validate Gradebook item before update (#14853)
evidence.note: Added a validation of the selected Gradebook item before any Gradebook data is changed, and reorganised the update code so the automatic Gradebook item is not removed when validation fails.

evidence.title: SAK-51967 Rubrics protect against out-of-order criterion (#14090)
evidence.note: Changed the criterion reorder handler to filter out unknown IDs, log a warning naming the missing IDs and rubric, and keep unmentioned criteria so the order column stays contiguous.

evidence.title: Review on SAK-52918
evidence.note: The reviewer found two logic faults in the analytics code. Instructor totals count only the viewer's Sent folder. Role/group filtering drops replies, so threads are wrongly marked unanswered. The reviewer asked for replies to be tracked separately from the filters.

evidence.title: SAK-51936 Kernel broaden mime-magic ignore to js, html, htm, css, txt (#14070)
evidence.note: Fixed wrong MIME detection of HTML files containing XHTML markers by broadening the ignore-extension defaults (js, html, htm, css, txt) and normalizing the config lists to lowercase. Added test documents for both cases.

evidence.title: SAK-50861 Conversations fix retrieval of posts because of null grading id (#13192)
evidence.note: The person traced the failure to a null grading item id passed to the grading service. They added a null check that skips the grade lookup and logs at debug level. They also quoted the exception while debugging in the discussion.

evidence.title: SAK-51695 SakaiGrader submission history order (#13905)
evidence.note: Fixed the wrong history order in the Sakai grader. Log property keys were being read in unsorted key order. The code now parses the numeric suffix of each key and sorts by it, so entries appear chronologically. The code comment states the reason for the sort.

evidence.title: SAK-52111 cloud-content handle okhttp3 error when response is not 200 (#14189)
evidence.note: The author fixed leaked OkHttp response bodies in the blob store handler. A code comment names the cause: Spring may never read the response, for example on a 304. The response is now wrapped in try-with-resources, and the spill-to-disk path was reworked.

evidence.title: SAK-51775 Webcomponents notifications prevent duplicate site titles (#14175)
evidence.note: Changed notification decoration to copy each notification instead of mutating the shared object, so site titles are no longer appended again on each filtering. Added a regression test that filters twice and checks the title is unchanged.

evidence.title: SAK-52631 SiteInfo import Announcements before Assignments to handle cleanup routines (#14682)
evidence.note: Fixed the import order in SiteManageServiceImpl so Announcements import runs before Assignments. A code comment explains the cause: Announcements cleanup would otherwise remove announcements that Assignments recreates. Unit and e2e tests were added.

evidence.title: SAK-52818 SiteInfo DateManager display correct Gradebook weekdays across DST (#14834)
evidence.note: Fixed a weekday display bug in the date picker script by computing the timezone offset from the selected date instead of today's date. A code comment states why: the offset can differ across daylight saving transitions.

evidence.title: SAK-51031 Signup need to commitEvent after opening a CalendarEventEdit (#13323)
evidence.note: The author fixed leftover SAKAI_LOCKS entries by committing each CalendarEventEdit after it was opened. They added a commitEvent helper in SignupCalendarHelperImpl, touched several signup classes, and noted that SAKAI_LOCKS was empty afterwards.

evidence.title: SAK-51281 Assignments fix TransientPropertyValueException in transferCopyEntities (#13538)
evidence.note: Fixed a TransientPropertyValueException during assignment site copy. The AllPurposeItem is now saved before its access entries are created and saved, with code comments explaining the order. The change is about 10 lines in AssignmentServiceImpl.

evidence.title: SAK-50803 Sitestats "Reports Add" page shows detach warnings (#13147)
evidence.note: Traced the detach errors to a custom Wicket component left over from the Wicket 9 upgrade. Added explicit detach of the optgroup and body container in StylableSelectOptionsGroup.onDetach, and adjusted related page code and HTML.

evidence.title: SAK-51106 Conversations avoid endless calls to markpostsviewed (#13405)
evidence.note: Fixed endless markpostsviewed requests by tracking already-observed post ids in a Set, filtering them out, unobserving viewed posts, and rolling back tracking when the request fails. The code comments explain the retry logic.

evidence.title: SAK-52426 Samigo handle empty notification property on user (#14466)
evidence.note: Fixed a silent notification failure caused by an empty preference value. The new method handles missing properties, undefined values and type errors, logging a warning and defaulting to immediate notification.

evidence.title: SAK-51889 Lessons draft announcements showing in embedded widget (#14016)
evidence.note: Added explicit draft exclusion in the announcement entity provider, in the filtered-messages path and in the time-range check. A code comment explains that the existing viewable filter was not excluding drafts for instructors. The change was approved.

evidence.title: SAK-52033 Samigo allow slash markers in FIB rich text (#14423)
evidence.note: Traced the false error to the character-by-character scan of raw question text in checkPairErrorsFIB. Closing HTML tags add extra slashes. Fixed it by stripping HTML with Jsoup before scanning, and named the originating ticket and the caller.

evidence.title: Review on SAK-52824
evidence.note: The reviewer traced the flow from the LTI score callback through submittee flag handling to getSubmissionSubmittee() taking the first flagged row from a HashSet. They explained how the instructor launch could target the wrong student.

evidence.title: SAK-52810 Rubrics prevent duplicate scores in PDF exports (#14842)
evidence.note: Changed the PDF export and the grading component so points are shown as adjusted only when the override differs from the selected rating's points. Added a helper that computes the selected rating points, including the weighted case.

evidence.title: SAK-51138 Commons fix bad dates because of UTC assumption (#13439)
evidence.note: Removed the incorrect UTC conversion when reading timestamps in Post and Comment. A code comment states the cause: the database stores dates in the server timezone, so no manipulation is needed.

evidence.title: SAK-52531 Forums during import merge should not do cleanup (#14600)
evidence.note: Fixed merge import behaving like replace by threading a createDefaultForum flag through the transfer method, so merge keeps the default forum and replace skips it. A follow-up commit repaired the import. Code comments explain the modes.

evidence.title: SAK-51916 Lessons prevent null indexOf in oembed (#14043)
evidence.note: Fixed a null indexOf TypeError in the oembed script. getRequestUrl now returns an empty string when the provider has no apiendpoint. The caller treats that case as provider not found. A code comment names the opengraph fallback as the cause.

evidence.title: SAK-52117 Forums avoid stale id link issue (#14216)
evidence.note: Fixed a stale-id fault after import/replace by resetting cached tool state, handling a missing topic with a warning and error message, and making the manager return null instead of throwing. Discussion comments name a stale id as the cause.

evidence.title: SAK-29774 Entitybroker fix paging with users (#13506)
evidence.note: Reworked the start/limit handling in UserEntityProvider.getEntities: the limit is defaulted and capped by a configurable maximum, start is forced to at least 1, and first/last are computed from start and limit. Code comments explain the index conversion and the email-search exception.

evidence.title: SAK-52417 Assignments fix grade-file-only download all zip (#14503)
evidence.note: Fixed the download-all zip so that per-student entries are only created when a submission or feedback option is selected. This was done with a helper method, and the check was applied in two code paths.

evidence.title: SAK-52825 Lessons preserve MIME type when resizing embedded content (#14925)
evidence.note: Fixed a regression in which editing an embedded item's size erased its stored MIME type. Changes were made in SimplePageBean and ShowPageProducer. The commit message names the symptom but not the cause.

evidence.title: SAK-52468 SiteInfo Import update refs for granular imports (#14501)
evidence.note: One-line condition change in the site import service so a tool is also processed when it appears in toolItemMap or toolOptions, which fixes references to the gradebook being lost on granular imports.

evidence.title: SAK-52509 Assignment avoid null all groups unlock (#14706)
evidence.note: Added a guard in AssignmentServiceImpl so a blank user id returns early. This stops the null-user unlock call that produced the warnings in the server logs.

evidence.title: SAK-52838 Lessons prevent from creating /blti/null items (#14849)
evidence.note: Changed the LTI deep-link callback so that when no usable resource link exists it logs a warning, shows an alert, switches to the error panel and returns, instead of creating a /blti/null item.

evidence.title: SAK-52520 SiteInfo guard manual course range (#14705)
evidence.note: The author changed a Velocity template to guard the manual course range loop, using a null check on the manual add number and a computed bound. This addresses the logged null range-operator error. The commit message is a title only.

evidence.title: SAK-50007 SiteManage SakaiDatePicker prevent 5-digit years (#13493)
evidence.note: Wrapped the date conversion in the controller in try/catch. An invalid date now logs a warning and shows an error message instead of silently returning to the Site Info page.

evidence.title: SAK-51239 Samigo fix timed assessments with late exceptions (#13725)
evidence.note: Changed the timed-assessment runnable so a student with an extended due date who starts after the regular due date gets the extended time limit. The change is a conditional branch with a log line; a code comment explains the case.

evidence.title: SAK-52070 Assignments guard null instructions (#14162)
evidence.note: Added a null guard in the Velocity template so the instructions length is only checked when instructions exist, removing the logged null-comparison error. The instructions are first stored in a local variable.

evidence.title: SAK-51435 content-review TurnitinOC NPE when checking filename extension (#13665)
evidence.note: The author changed one line in processUnsubmitted so the filename extension check no longer throws a NullPointerException. The commit title names the NPE when checking the filename extension. The change was approved twice.

evidence.title: SAK-51661 Lessons fix subpage navigation highlighting (#13871)
evidence.note: The person changed one condition in the browser-side navigation script so the active subpage is highlighted instead of the main lessons page. The change was approved by a reviewer.

evidence.title: SAK-51483 assignments Fix LTI error when viewing non-LTI assignments (#13720)
evidence.note: The author fixed a regression in AssignmentAction.java by guarding the external-tool lookup with a check on submission type. The 'tool deleted' alert no longer appears for assignments that never used LTI. The change is small and was approved twice.

evidence.title: SAK-51535 Gradebook course grade export use raw entered grade instead of formatted display (#13874)
evidence.note: Changed the custom gradebook export so the course grade column uses the raw entered grade instead of the formatted display value, removing the FormatHelper warning for letter grades. One-line change, accepted by a reviewer.

evidence.title: Review on SAK-51153
evidence.note: The reviewer questioned a specific line in the aggregator job, recalling a past failure where the same events were reprocessed without progress. They asked whether the counter always advances by at least one, which points to a risk of an infinite loop.

evidence.title: SAK-51456 Grader updated the clear method in SakaiRubricGrading.js to… (#13689)
evidence.note: Changed the clear method in the rubric grading web component so it resets the private _evaluation field and also resets _totalPoints. The change was approved in review.

evidence.title: SAK-52103 Assignments clear content-review artifacts from state (#14183)
evidence.note: Added helper methods that clear stale plagiarism/Turnitin attributes from the Velocity context and session state, so Turnitin messaging no longer persists on a non-Turnitin submission view after cancel.

evidence.title: SAK-51264 Calendar fix date errors and datepicker errors (#13555)
evidence.note: Fixed a calendar bug where a past date reset to today. Changes were made in the datepicker script to parse YYYY-MM-DD values explicitly and set the date fields, and in the template to pass the value in that format.

evidence.title: SAK-51579 Commons retrieving likeRecord can produce an NPE (#13813)
evidence.note: Added a null guard on likeRecord in PersistenceManagerImpl so doesUserLike no longer throws an NPE. Also made the like count return 0 when null and improved log messages. The change was approved in review.

evidence.title: SAK-51687 Discussions Removed EL expressions from plain HTML spans (#13895)
evidence.note: Fixed a JSP compile failure (ClassNotFoundException for dfFlatView_jsp) by removing EL expressions from plain HTML span elements in three JSP files. The change was approved in review.

evidence.title: SAK-52888 Rubrics encode download filenames as UTF-8 (#14947)
evidence.note: Changed Content-Disposition header construction in two places (Samigo export and the Rubrics REST controller) to encode filenames as UTF-8, so non-ASCII student names no longer break the download header.

evidence.title: SAK-52230 Syllabus keep sanitized content in direct updates (#14346)
evidence.note: Changed the syllabus flow so AntiSamy warnings no longer block saving. Sanitized content is kept and saved, and the sanitizer notes are logged at debug level. Applied in both SyllabusTool and SyllabusEntityProvider, with two commits, the second covering direct updates.

evidence.title: SAK-52382 Samigo fix ShowMedia download behavior for file-upload grading (#14415)
evidence.note: Changed ShowMediaServlet to take the content type from the content resource, fall back to the media record's mime type, and force download when the type is generic or unknown. Also stored the content type on the media data and passed setMimeType=false from the JSPs.

evidence.title: SAK-51128 Assignment properly read sakai property assignment.usePeerAssessment (#13514)
evidence.note: Changed the attribute set in the edit path to store a String instead of a Boolean, and removed the redundant Boolean cast on the config call. This fixes the ClassCastException when the property is false. One human approval is recorded.

evidence.title: SAK-52435 Web copy all placement config on site import (#14714)
evidence.note: Replaced copying of a single property with a helper that copies all placement config properties from the source tool to the target during site import, rewriting the content URL for the new site context.

evidence.title: SAK-49900 Tasks should filter out future start dates (#14115)
evidence.note: Added a filter in the task service so tasks whose start date is in the future are excluded from the list returned to the student, fixing the reported dashboard behaviour. The null start date case is handled.

evidence.title: SAK-52502 Forums check permission before loading gradebook assignments (#15040)
evidence.note: Added a permission check before loading gradebook assignments in the Forums tool, so users without grading permissions no longer trigger the authorization failure log entries.

evidence.title: SAK-51074 Common merge detached instance before deleting SakaiPerson (#13393)
evidence.note: Changed the SakaiPerson delete path so the detached entity is merged into the Hibernate session before it is deleted. This addresses the 'Removing a detached instance' IllegalArgumentException from the stack trace. The change is four lines and has a short code comment.

evidence.title: SAK-52663 Samigo preserve part order in markup text export (#15038)
evidence.note: Changed the export loop in AssessmentService to iterate over the sorted section array, so reordered test parts are exported in their set order. This is a one-line fix to the behaviour described in the bug.

evidence.title: SAK-50203 Gradebook fix getStringIgnoreSettings wicket loading error (#13368)
evidence.note: The person fixed a Wicket warning in BulkGradePanel. Constructor-time fields were added, and the setup logic moved into onInitialize after super.onInitialize(). Localized strings are therefore no longer fetched before the component is attached to the page.

evidence.title: SAK-52063 Assignments downgrade gradebook feed warning (#14164)
evidence.note: Changed a one-line log statement in the assignment entity provider from a warning to debug level, so the expected null property no longer produces a server warning. The change was approved in review.

evidence.title: SAK-52837 SiteInfo preserve existing participant warnings across redirects (#14905)
evidence.note: Changed the controller so that messages are passed through flash attributes on redirect and merged into the model otherwise. This restores the missing existing-participant warning.

evidence.title: SAK-51887 Assignments remove assignment reminder title truncation (#14015)
evidence.note: The person fixed the reminder email so it uses the full assignment title instead of a truncated one. The change is small, touches one file and removes some helper code (+9/-16).

evidence.title: SAK-52084 Samigo fix ClassCastException from XmlBeans upgrade (#14173)
evidence.note: Fixed a ClassCastException that appeared after an XmlBeans upgrade. They built a type loader union of the QTI type system and the built-in one, and used it to instantiate the document. A code comment gives the reason. The change was approved.

evidence.title: SAK-51680 DateManager updating a draft discussion fails silently (#14052)
evidence.note: Changed the forum branch in DateManagerServiceImpl so draft forums, whose entity type has an extra suffix, are matched by a startsWith check and saved. This fixes the silent failure on draft discussions. The change is a few lines and was approved.

evidence.title: SAK-41206 Gradebook nice error message when Strict Open XML format (#14168)
evidence.note: Added a catch for POIXMLException in the grade import upload step. It logs the exception, shows a user-facing error message and returns, so the stack trace no longer reaches the user when a Strict Open XML file is uploaded.

evidence.title: SAK-51898 Lessons don't reset item descriptions when reassigning to different target (#14422)
evidence.note: The person changed SimplePageBean.java so that Lessons stops resetting item descriptions when a link is reassigned to a different target. The commit title is the only text they wrote.

evidence.title: SAK-52582 Gradebook reject an invalid number instead of parsing it (#14614)
evidence.note: Changed the gradebook score update so an input is validated with the locale service first and rejected if invalid, instead of being parsed into a wrong value such as 3,3 becoming 33.

evidence.title: SAK-51682 Gradebook export respects student number visibility permission (#13890)
evidence.note: Changed the export panel to read the student number visibility once from the business service and to include the student number column only when it is visible and, for a custom export, was selected. Five lines added, four removed.

evidence.title: SAK-52397 Dashboard hide draft and unavailable announcements (#14510)
evidence.note: Added a one-line filter in the announcements controller so draft and unavailable announcements are excluded from the dashboard widget, fixing the reported bug.

evidence.title: SAK-51518 Conversations improve behavior when deleting tags (#13785)
evidence.note: Fixed tag-deletion behaviour in Conversations: topics that used a deleted tag are updated, null tags are filtered out in the backend and frontend, and a unique constraint was added on topic tags.

evidence.title: SAK-51958 Samigo guard null tag set (#14083)
evidence.note: Added null guards in ItemService so that a null tag set no longer causes an NPE when saving tags for hashed questions. The original tag set is copied defensively as well. The change was approved twice.

evidence.title: SAK-52866 Statistics preserve user activity search when returning from details (#14902)
evidence.note: Fixed lost selection on returning from the details page by passing the search parameters (user, tool, dates, page) through the Show more and Back links, and by binding the form model in the controller.

evidence.title: SAK-50966 Profile2 fix feedback error message (#13403)
evidence.note: One-line change in FeedbackLabel so the label model uses the message text of the first feedback message instead of the whole FeedbackMessage object. This removes the unfriendly raw object output shown to users on bad input.

evidence.title: SAK-52794 Statistics return report previews to the editor (#14908)
evidence.note: Fixed a regression in the Back link of the report preview. Added an edit route for previews, a service method that rebuilds the report form from the preview, and a template link that goes back to the editor when a preview is shown.

evidence.title: SAK-52061 Overview ability to add overview back after removal (#14167)
evidence.note: Added a five-line change in SiteAction that clears the custom-overview site property and resets the flag, so Overview can be added back to the navigation after removal. The commit message states only the symptom, not the cause.

evidence.title: SAK-51102 Library fix headscripts eval (#13401)
evidence.note: Fixed a TypeError in showNotif by replacing an eval call with direct form element access, guarded by checks that the form and button element exist, and a guard on document.showItem.

evidence.title: SAK-52467 Forums improved gradebook link handling for imported discussion forums and topics (#14502)
evidence.note: Changed the forum and topic import code so that, when the gradebook item is not mapped, the default assignment name is cleared. This stops an imported topic from keeping a link to the original site's rubric.

evidence.title: SAK-51420 Grader Fix navigation when toggling submittedOnly filter (#13705)
evidence.note: Fixed a TypeError during navigation with the submitted-only filter by checking whether the neighbouring submission is hydrated, fetching it if not, and logging an error when the selected submission is missing.

evidence.title: SAK-50828 Calendar fix NPE during import from site (#13159)
evidence.note: Added a null guard around the current tool placement and its context before setting the site id on a calendar edit, which fixes the NPE during site import. A reviewer approved it. Their comments call it a one-line fix for the import NPE.

evidence.title: SAK-52931 Lessons disable links to deleted assignments and topics (#15043)
evidence.note: Changed a two-line condition in ShowPageProducer so that links to deleted items (checked via objectExists) are not rendered as active for the instructor.

evidence.title: SAK-51462 Samigo fix sorting on score column on Questions page (#13692)
evidence.note: Fixed a JSP property-not-found error on the Questions score sort. Added an itemData property to the bean, set it in the listener, and added a fallback in the update listener that looks up the item by itemId when it is null.

evidence.title: SAK-51060 Rubrics avoid throwing an exception when user doesn't have the edit permission (#13359)
evidence.note: The backend now returns an empty list with a debug log when the user lacks the edit permission, instead of throwing. The test was updated to expect an empty list, and the frontend component handles empty or non-JSON responses.

evidence.title: SAK-50952 Samigo fix publishing targets in site without groups (#13278)
evidence.note: Fixed a bug where sites without groups still required selecting a group. Publishing targets now depend on whether the site has groups, and a validateTarget method checks a target against the valid list. Applied in both settings beans.

evidence.title: SAK-50765 Conversations dont fetch grades unless you have grading permission (#13404)
evidence.note: Replaced an immutable Map.of() with a HashMap in the notification replacements, and commented that the email template service calls putAll() on it.

evidence.title: SAK-51086 Gradebook solve settings onSubmit error (#13384)
evidence.note: Replaced the plain AjaxButton with the project's GbAjaxButton on the settings page submit and adjusted the button markup and the category panel's onSubmit. This addresses the Wicket 'unexpected invocation of #onSubmit()' warning. The cause is not explained in the commit.

evidence.title: SAK-51929 Dashboard course cards: fix image sizing/cropping by using background-image (#14047)
evidence.note: Replaced the inline background shorthand with a background-image-only style via Lit styleMap, so the stylesheet's size, position and repeat rules apply. Also set background-repeat: no-repeat in the SCSS. Fix reviewed and approved twice.

evidence.title: SAK-52940 Rubrics guard save banners when collapsed (#15074)
evidence.note: Fixed a null reference error (reading classList) in the SakaiRubric web component by guarding the save banner access when the rubric is collapsed. One file changed, and it was approved by a reviewer.

evidence.title: SAK-52881 Gradebook fix student summary category toggle (#15020)
evidence.note: Fixed the student summary category toggle in the gradebook. Items within a category are now sorted by sort order, with nulls last, and the toggle links in the panel markup were adjusted.

evidence.title: Review on SAK-51199
evidence.note: The reviewer pointed at a specific line in SakaiLTIUtil.java and noted that passing the exception to the debug log call prints the whole stack trace, which relates to the traceback described in the bug.

evidence.title: SAK-51664 Gradebook Fix percentage display precision to 2 decimal places (#13878)
evidence.note: Restored the earlier percentage calculation in GradingServiceImpl so student summaries show percentages, then in a follow-up fixed the displayed precision to 2 decimals and passed gradeType to the panels.

evidence.title: SAK-52748 LTI Fix Ignite keyset cache name (#14779)
evidence.note: Changed the configured Ignite cache name in ignite-components.xml to the package name that Sakai 25 requests, so the eternal cache declaration matches the runtime cache. The change is one line; the commit message names only the keyset cache name.

evidence.title: SAK-51348 Lessons add missing fonts template to fix RSF error (#13724)

assessments.rationale: The records show 50 units of interface work, as author and as reviewer. In the strongest cases the person explained causes: shadow DOM and an earlier styles removal behind the dark-theme select arrow, and, as reviewer, a misused ARIA progressbar role, flex-wrap: nowrap blocking align-content, and semantic and accessibility reasons for replacing icon tags. Many authored changes fixed accessibility and contrast problems, such as drag-handle buttons, real button elements, focus handling, and dark-mode colors. Others restyled templates with Bootstrap classes or swapped icon sets. A number were small class or layout edits following the ticket. Other review comments covered deprecated table attributes, hard-coded tooltip colors, theme variables, and the wording of a student warning.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because for SAK-51690 the person tied the dark-theme select arrow problem to shadow DOM and an earlier styles removal, and a review approved the change. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records show no interface work that other people build on or depend on, such as a shared component or pattern others adopted. Most of the other units were individual fixes or review comments.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The records cover 104 units of test work. In the largest group the person added unit, web-component or Playwright end-to-end tests alongside fixes and features, for example regression tests for gradebook excusing, null-user group lookups, NaN sorting, locale handling, emoji encoding and tag removal. In the locale-dependent tests for FormatHelper, the person made the tests set and restore the default locale, added separate US and Spanish assertions, and added a CI step under the ES locale, with a comment that the comma is a thousands separator in the US. The person rewrote tests across several modules from PowerMock to Mockito's MockedStatic, and replaced the Cypress suite with about 25 Playwright classes and shared helpers. The person also documented the transactional design of the tag service in a class comment next to new tests. As reviewer, the person suggested a Spanish-locale test change and mentioned adding a Cypress test. One web-component test edit followed the removal of a Cancel button.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because in the FormatHelper locale fix the person explained that the failures came from the default locale and noted in a code comment why the comma differs in the US. It is not "Others rely on it" because, although shared Playwright helpers were built, the records show no one else depending on them. Most units are single tests added with a fix, and the records give no sign that other people built on or used the person's test pieces.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The records cover 124 units of browser-side work. In about twenty units the person explained a cause or reworked the logic behind a problem. They explained why mouse drag broke once handles became buttons, kept the rendered hierarchy so reply nesting could be restored after date sorting, and stopped a gradebook check from polling after a 403. They restructured pagination, the date picker, dialogs and DataTables sorting, and removed the Fluid Infusion library across several tools. As reviewer, the person traced faults to their causes in several comments, including DST handling in a date picker, "undefined" being written into an attribute, and a crop drag that was not saved. In most other units the person made small fixes or additions to scripts, templates and web components. As reviewer, the person also asked questions or gave suggestions on markup and Lit patterns.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because in SAK-51269 the person stated that jQuery UI's cancel option blocked dragging on button handles and changed that option. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records show no shared frontend piece that other parts of the system visibly depend on, and no work that others build on. Most units are fixes or restructurings inside a single feature.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The records cover 37 units, mostly changes at the points where Sakai tools or external systems meet. In several, the person explained why a change was needed: publish-on-import integrations with announcements and calendar, a system-wide destination for admin transfers, pushing SCORM grades to the Gradebook, and mapping delegated-access users to the maintain role in LTI. The person also moved publishing logic into the assignment service, rewrote the SCORM player launch around a REST controller, and reworked Samigo gradebook removal for group gradebooks. In about twenty further units the person made smaller fixes or feature changes across LTI, SCORM, Samigo, Gradebook links, import and copy, and FOP upgrades. As reviewer, the person suggested a URIBuilder replacement for hand-written URL parsing, and in other reviews raised short questions or remarks.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because in SAK-52126 the person explained in a code comment that admin transfers affect links across all sites, so the destination must be system-wide. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records do not show a shared integration piece that other parts or people depend on. The person's work at these seams is mostly fixes and restructures within one area.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The person extended the shared UserSortNameComparator to accept a locale and added a SakaiCollators helper, which was applied across many tools and tested for Spanish, Swedish and US ordering. assessments.rationale: The records show six pieces of written explanation by the person as author. In discussion comments on the SCORM and gradebook export issues, the person explained how Terminate hands the data model to the ADL library, when completion status is derived, and the root cause of each export column problem, naming files and locations. On the accessibility issue, the person replied that the styling came from the browser's user agent stylesheet or extensions and could not be reproduced with aXe. On the Lessons issue, the person described how an earlier change broke old embeds such as PowerPoint and how the second commit reverts it. In reply to a reviewer on the fluid infusion removal, the person explained the history of the rank feature and why it was not worth testing. On the Thymeleaf upgrade, the person listed the tools to regression-test and advised pausing until SAK-52575 is committed.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because on SAK-51879 the person explained in their own words how Terminate passes the data model to the ADL library and when completion status is derived. assessments.rationale: The person authored three large migrations from generic-dao to JPA and Spring repositories: the account validation tool, EntityBroker (hundreds of files) and the Hierarchy tool, which also got DDL scripts for three databases. Other authored work changed Hibernate mappings and cleanup SQL for forum permission levels, with an explanation of which cleanup case to run first and why. It also covered column length and default changes across several modules, and a batch delete that builds a new CriteriaDelete per batch. As reviewer, the person commented on persistence code in twelve units. In seven of them the person explained a cause or cost, such as Oracle IN-list batching, a heavy site save, and Hibernate-specific save, and suggested a fix. The other five gave shorter pointers on delete by id, session.get, SQL injection, optimistic locking and ID generation, or asked a bare question.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Others rely on it" because the person's migration of EntityBroker to JPA and Spring repositories replaced a shared persistence layer that many components now depend on, with tests and an approving review. It is not "Sets the approach for others" because the records do not show the person defining a persistence approach or standard that other people are expected to follow, beyond doing the migrations and commenting on individual reviews. The records leave this close to the next level, since the migration guide and the many review suggestions already steer how others write persistence code.
assessments.blind_spots: private conversation and pair work that never hit the tracker; work outside the observation window

assessments.rationale: The records cover 56 units of debugging work, mostly bug fixes the person authored plus a set of review comments. In about a dozen fixes the person named the cause in code comments or discussion: a listener attached after a fetch finished, duplicate scroll-detection posts producing duplicate TopicStatus errors, a Set built unsafely in a getter, duplicate or late Ajax callbacks, a PermissionException leading to an NPE, and a null attachment list. They fixed these at the source. In many other fixes, covering null checks, form validation, parsing, transactions, logging levels and reverts after failing tests, the person changed behaviour without a written cause. The person, as reviewer, spotted a mismatched cache key, explained a JDK reflective-access exception, and described a tool-status comparison fault. They also gave smaller suggestions on logging, truncation, casts and unreachable catch blocks.
assessments.level_reason: This fits "Solves and explains the cause" because in SAK-51594 the person explained that a PermissionException caused an NPE that aborted the grades endpoint, and then fixed that root cause. It is not "Others rely on it" because the records show no sign that other people depend on the person's debugging work, such as fixes or diagnoses that others build on. The same holds for the person's review diagnoses, which stay with individual changes.
